votes.motion: Council Member Hull, seconded by Council Member Ferguson, moved to close the open session of the staff meeting to discuss security
Council Member Peel, seconded by Council Member Prokopis, moved to close the staff meeting and go into the public meeting
Council Member Ferguson, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to approve the minutes of the Magna Metro Township meeting held on July 17, 2018
Council Member Prokopis, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve the resolution

Council Member Peel, seconded by Council Member Hull, moved to approve the rezone application 30632 from an A-1 z/c to an R-1-7, with zoning conditions as follows: limit the gross density to no more than 3.9 units per acre, and require a minimum 10,000 square foot lots against the Hibler Drive subdivision, with 20 percent of the remaining lots at 8,000 and greater square foot lots, and a minimum lot width of 76 feet
Council Member Ferguson, seconded by Council Member Peel, moved to set the date of Tuesday, September 25, 2018, to accept public comment and consider the requests
